entries: Then I shall find my own way out and meet you again.
那我就自己找路出去，再与你们会合。
Greetings. I am sure you have an exciting tale to tell.
致意。我相信你有一段精彩的故事要讲。
Light. Inside cocoon. @ saw. Kept you safe?
光。茧里面。@ 看见了。护住了你？
Again, thank you for freeing me. Now let us get out of here.
再次感谢你解救了我。现在，我们离开这里吧。
I must have been in there for days... weeks? I have no idea. Too long, that's for sure.
我在里面一定待了好几天……也许几周？我完全不知道。反正，太久了。
The thought of being trapped in a cocoon... no thanks.
一想到被关在茧里……不了，谢谢。
Detail no matter. You free. Why humans care so about past? Many Scaphin not survive. You lucky.
细节不重要。你，自由了。人类为什么这么在意过去？许多斯卡芬都没能活下来。你，幸运。
It must have been quite an ordeal. What is your name?
那一定是一段煎熬。你叫什么名字？
Free at last! I thought I was done for. I was in there for days!
终于自由了！我以为自己完了。我在里面待了好几天！
How long were you in there?
I know what it's like to feel trapped, but this is much worse.
被困住是什么滋味，我懂；可你这遭遇要糟得多。
Indeed. I will not take this second chance lightly.
确实。这第二次机会，我不会轻慢对待。
Oh, I do! It is quite a tale. But... perhaps we could leave here first.
哦，当然有！那可是段了不得的故事。不过……也许我们先离开这里再说。
I appreciate your freeing me, but clearly you have no room. Please do not take me for a fool, and let me know if you change your mind.
谢谢你救我出来，可你们显然没有空位了。别把我当傻子，要是改变主意，告诉我一声。
